title: 第一卷 第12章 分家清算！
slug: 一路逃荒一路富手握空间带飞全家
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

动手的日子到了。

沈鹿溪起得比往常更早，天海黑着就把柳荞娘和沈大山叫了起来。

“娘，把值钱的东西都收好，贴身放着。爹，今天不管发生什么，你站在我身后就行，别跟奶奶吵，别动手，话我来说。”

沈大山应了一声，点了点头。

柳荞娘手指有些抖，沈鹿溪握了握她的手：“娘，今天过后，咱们就自由了。”

柳荞娘深吸了口气，把那个藏铜板的布包塞进贴身衣兜里。

沈小满揉着眼睛从炕上坐了起来：“姐，怎么了？”

“没事，你今天乖乖待在屋里，哪儿都别去。”

巳时刚过，院门外传来说笑声。

张媒婆打头，身后跟着个胖墩墩的老头，穿着绸缎褂子，手上戴着个翡翠扳指，走路大摇大摆的。

周员外。

五十出头，圆脸，小眼睛，笑起来眼睛眯成一条缝，看着和气，可那双眼珠子滴溜溜的转，精明得很。

前世就是这张脸，笑嘻嘻的把银子递给王桂花，然后让人把她塞进轿子里抬走的。

沈鹿溪站在自家小屋的窗户后面，看着周员外迈进院门，面上没有半点波澜。

王桂花今天难得穿了件体面衣裳，头上还多簪了一根铜簪子，笑得满脸开花地把人迎进正房。

赵翠屏端着茶水跟在后面伺候，嘴甜得跟摸了蜜似的：“周老爷您请坐，您请喝茶。”

沈大牛也出来了，难得没有赖在炕上，站在堂屋里陪着说话。

沈金宝倒是没露面，大概是心虚，躲起来了。

沈鹿溪等了大约一刻钟。

正房里传出王桂花的声音，中气十足：“老二！老二家的！都过来！”

沈鹿溪没动，她在等人。

又过了一小会儿，院门外传来脚步声。

听着是好几个人的。

柳老爹走在最前面，身板挺得笔直，腰间别着猎刀。

他身后跟着大舅柳青山和二舅柳青河，两个人都是壮实的庄稼汉，肩宽膀圆，脸上的表情不太好看。

在后面是方秉文，依旧是那件洗得发白的长衫，袖子里揣着分家文书，不紧不慢地走着，

最后面是里正沈德厚，背着手，一脸“我来看看”的表情。

院门口已经围了不少村民。

村里一家挨着一家，消息传得快，一大早就有人看见柳家村来了人，又看见讼师和里正往沈家走，就都知道有热闹看了。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The day of action has arrived.

Shen Luxi got up earlier than usual, and when the sky was dark, he called Liu Qiaoniang and Shen Dashan.

"Mom, put all the valuable things away and keep them close to you. Dad, no matter what happens today, just stand behind me. Don't argue with grandma. Don't make any moves. I'll tell you."

Shen Dashan responded and nodded.

Liu Qiao Niang's fingers were trembling a little, and Shen Luxi shook her hand: "Mom, after today, we will be free."

Liu Qiaoniang took a deep breath and stuffed the cloth bag with the copper plate into her pocket.

Shen Xiaoman rubbed his eyes and sat up from the kang: "Sister, what's wrong?"

"It's okay, just stay in the house today and don't go anywhere."

Just after midnight, laughter came from outside the courtyard gate.

Matchmaker Zhang took the lead, followed by a fat old man, wearing a satin gown and an jade ring on his hand, walking with a swagger.

Zhou Yuanwai.

He is in his early fifties, with a round face and small eyes. When he smiles, his eyes narrow into slits. He looks friendly, but his eyes are rolling and very shrewd.

It was this face in the previous life. He handed the money to Wang Guihua with a smile, and then had people put her into a sedan and carry her away.

Shen Luxi stood behind the window of his hut, watching Mr. Zhou walk out of the courtyard door without any emotion on his face.

Wang Guihua rarely wore decent clothes today, and she even had an extra copper hairpin on her head. She welcomed her into the main room with a smile on her face.

Zhao Cuiping followed behind with tea and waited on him. His mouth was as sweet as honey: "Mr. Zhou, please sit down and drink tea."

Shen Daniu also came out. It was rare that he did not lie on the kang and stood in the main room to talk with him.

Shen Jinbao didn't show up, probably because he felt guilty and hid.

Shen Luxi waited for about a quarter of an hour.

Wang Guihua's voice came from the main room, full of anger: "Second brother! Everyone from the second brother's family! Come here!"

Shen Luxi didn't move, she was waiting for someone.

After a while, footsteps were heard outside the courtyard door.

It sounded like it belonged to several people.

Father Liu walked in the front, his body straight and a hunting knife on his waist.

Behind him were his eldest uncle Liu Qingshan and his second uncle Liu Qinghe. Both of them were sturdy farmers with broad shoulders and round arms, and the expressions on their faces were not very good-looking.

Behind him is Fang Bingwen, still wearing the white washed gown, with the family separation documents in his sleeves, walking leisurely,

At the end is Shen Dehou, who is standing upright, with his hands behind his back and a look on his face that says, "Let me take a look."

Many villagers have gathered at the entrance of the courtyard.

One house in the village is next to the other, and the news spreads quickly. Early in the morning, someone saw someone coming from Liujia Village, and saw the lawyer and Li Zheng walking towards Shen's house, so they all knew there was something going on.
